globals.name: D_80057FB8
globals.evidence: Halfword volume storage, explicitly sign-extended before signed division by two. Another consumer at 0x8001742C loads it with lh. This establishes a short scalar at this address.

function_evidence: Volume arguments are checked through their low unsigned 16 bits against 0x100; accepted values are stored as halfwords. A caller passes -1 to preserve each stored volume while reapplying the CD mixer. Void return is consistent with inspected callers. CdlATV val1/val3 are zero; val0/val2 receive the signed stored CD volume divided by two with truncation toward zero and conversion to unsigned char. Only four mixer bytes are established. The exact matching C and whole-file gate support a viable parameter representation, not proof of the original spelling or compiler version.
